div.span:
The spine is the golden thread: Outcome, Platform, Capability, Bounded context, ABB, SBB, Service, extended here with the landscape above it and the node below it.
Platform is the unit of ownership and consumption; domain is the problem space it serves. The two usually coincide and are never the same thing.
An ABB lives inside one bounded context: this bundle's rule, where TOGAF leaves a block enterprise-wide. Reuse is through a pattern that names it, or a cross-cutting platform.
Architecture pattern and reference architecture are two types of one construct (Kruchten, Bass). A pattern's abstraction is read from its boxes; the ladder reads it: R3 logical, R4 physical.
A service is the C4 container that executes code: separately built, versioned, released and deployed, inside one bounded context, run by a product, deployed to nodes.
Own conventions: the rung, the consideration, product runs service, store as a resource (as Backstage). The rest: TOGAF 10, O-AA, DDD, Team Topologies, CNCF, C4, Backstage, ArchiMate 3.2, the cloud Well-Architected frameworks.
Solid arrow: a relationship recorded in front matter. Dashed arrow: may point at any level.
